newsitem.title: UK: Property group Minerva plans UK market listing.
newsitem.headline: Property group Minerva plans UK market listing.

text.p: Minerva Plc, a commercial property investment and development company, said on Friday it planned to seek a listing on the London Stock Exchange, probably by means of an institutional placing.
The company said it would use the proceeds from the issue to strengthen its balance sheet, acquire property and develop its existing real estate interests.
Minerva said it had bought property in Wigmore Street in the West End of London for 37.0 million stg from Ladbroke, in a deal conditional on the float.
On flotation the company will have gross assets of 402.0 million stg with 45 percent of its property portfolio in the West End of London and a further 35 percent in Greater London.
The sponsor to the flotation will be HSBC Samuel Montagu and the stockbroker will by HSBC James Capel.
